curriculumGapRegister.rule: Every official KSB → exactly 1 defensible Primary training block before programme publication
curriculumGapRegister.status: PUBLICATION BLOCKED — 14 required KSBs have no defensible Primary yet

K24.rationale: First dedicated customer-service teaching (scenarios + dispute resolution)

S15.rationale: First clear practical customer-service skill application

K12.rationale: Advanced Brake Diagnostics strongest primary; B3 wear checks = reinforcement

S12.rationale: Wheel Alignment - Advanced first explicit geometry teaching; no B3 artefact

K30.rationale: Earliest clear team-working via bay discipline/handoffs; B8 advanced; B10 consolidation

S3.rationale: W27 Housekeeping/5S/safe storage first teaching home

S1.rationale: Earliest sustained workplace H&S practice; later blocks specialist/reinforcement

S4.rationale: Clearest tool-control teaching; B3/B8 reinforcement; B9 dropped unless tool-cal evidence

K29.rationale: First estimates/authorisation teaching; later quotation blocks reinforcement

S19.rationale: Aligned with K30→B3; B8 advanced delegation reinforcement

S14.rationale: First dedicated high-intensity record-keeping/compliance/audit teaching; B8 advanced; B10 consolidation

groups.title: Equity, diversity, inclusion & inclusive workplace
missingTeaching: Explicit EDI principles and workplace impact (K31)
Complying with EDI guidance in practice (S20)
Supporting an inclusive workplace / respectful of different views (B5)

likelyHostBlocks.why: Customer Interaction — natural early professional behaviours/customer context
Workshop Processes — already Primary home for several workplace behaviours/skills
Consolidation — can reinforce but usually weak as first Primary unless new dedicated session

proposedPrimaryAfterAmendment.rationale: Align with approved workplace-behaviour Primaries (B1/B2/S1/S2/S3 → B3). Only valid once an explicit EDI session/activity exists.

groups.title: Industry context, technician role, autonomy & reporting
missingTeaching: Automotive industry context
Role of the autocare technician
Limits of autonomy
Reporting channels

likelyHostBlocks.why: Foundation Skills / induction — logical home IF approved FS↔KSB crosswalk + explicit content are added
Early specialist block if B1 remains without coded KSB ownership

proposedPrimaryAfterAmendment.rationale: Best pedagogical fit for induction/role context, but NOT defensible until Block 1 has explicit content and approved KSB mapping evidence.

groups.title: Safety inspection & routine maintenance to manufacturer data/schedules
missingTeaching: Manufacturer specifications / approved maintenance schedules (K2)
Vehicle-specific data use and legal wear/serviceability requirements (K2)
Apply safety inspection and routine maintenance procedures using vehicle-specific data (S7)

likelyHostBlocks.why: Already hosts intake/inspection and service themes — strongest logical early host once content is explicit
Brake/tyre wear checks exist but currently lack schedule/spec/data teaching
Consolidation practice only after Primary teaching exists earlier

proposedPrimaryAfterAmendment.rationale: Natural Primary for K2+S7 together once an explicit inspection-to-spec/data session is added (e.g. strengthen W16 or insert dedicated week).

groups.title: Workplace instructions (purpose and use)
missingTeaching: What workplace instructions are
Purpose and use for inspection, maintenance and replacement
Applying instructions as a taught object of learning (not assumed)

likelyHostBlocks.why: Intake/inspection workflow
Workshop procedures/documentation already present
Process discipline / record quality weeks

proposedPrimaryAfterAmendment.rationale: W26 workshop procedures/documentation is the best amendment target; Primary only after explicit 'workplace instructions' learning objectives/evidence exist.

groups.title: Emission control systems knowledge
missingTeaching: Purpose/function/location of emission control systems
Catalytic converters, evaporative controls, EGR, DPF, PPF, SCR

likelyHostBlocks.why: Systems inspection progression
Complex repair/diagnostic context
Consolidation/EPA systems practice — weak as sole Primary

proposedPrimaryAfterAmendment.rationale: Best diagnostic/systems home once a dedicated emissions session is added; do not use current suspension/inspection proximity.

groups.title: Fluids & filtration (knowledge + skill)
missingTeaching: Fluid and filtration systems: brake fluid, oil/oil filters, air filters (K20)
Check and replace fluids and filtration parts (S25)

likelyHostBlocks.why: Service/inspection pathway — logical practical home
Foundation workshop practice
Consolidation only after Primary teaching exists

proposedPrimaryAfterAmendment.rationale: Co-locate K20+S25 in an early service block with an explicit fluids/filters practical; not brake-diagnostics by association.

groups.title: Information & digital technology / GDPR / cyber
missingTeaching: Digital technology systems: email, collaboration, databases, MIS, POS, equipment interfaces (K34)
GDPR and cyber security (K34/S23)
Use information and digital technology systems in practice (S23)

likelyHostBlocks.why: VIN/technical data / process-digital touchpoints
Advanced workshop practice — if digital job systems are taught explicitly
Emerging tech block — only if digital/GDPR content is added (not stock-security)
Portfolio/EPA digital evidence practices

proposedPrimaryAfterAmendment.rationale: Best early data/systems fit once explicit GDPR/cyber/digital session exists; stock-security must never be used as evidence.

groups.title: ADAS levels of autonomy (passive/active)
missingTeaching: ADAS levels of autonomy
Passive vs active advanced driver assistance systems

likelyHostBlocks.why: Emerging technologies / pre-calibration adjacency (W89 teaches pre-checks, not autonomy levels)
Consolidation only after Primary teaching is added

proposedPrimaryAfterAmendment.rationale: Extend emerging-tech/ADAS strand with an explicit autonomy-levels session (W89/W90 amendment or new week). Current pre-calibration content is insufficient alone.

groups.title: HV battery / charger state-of-health testing
missingTeaching: State-of-health condition monitoring tests on high voltage batteries
SoH / condition monitoring of onboard chargers
Explicit practical activity (not generic EV awareness/safety)

likelyHostBlocks.why: Already Primary for K21/K23/S13 EV service/safety — best host if SoH practical is added
EV specialty block — alternative if SoH practical is placed in emerging-tech pathway

proposedPrimaryAfterAmendment.rationale: Keep with approved EV Primary cluster (K21/K23/S13 → B6) once a real SoH testing activity is added to W54 or a new adjacent week.

Specify new session vs amend existing vs practical/assessment artefacts
Amend SOW with explicit teaching evidence
Then set exactly one Primary per KSB and optional Reinforcement
Only then persist Block↔KSB mappings and later curriculumValue
